svg.aria-label: A spill at 2 a.m. on day 17 is missed by the monthly grab sample and caught by AquaSentinel within one 15-minute cycle.

g.text: A spill lasts hours. A sample comes once a month.
Dissolved solids in a river over 30 days, with one night-time discharge (illustration, not measured data)
AquaSentinel sees it within one 15-min cycle
AquaSentinel, every 15 minutes: 2,880 readings a month
